description: Statistical data for all 6-digit postcodes in the Netherlands, published by CBS (Statistics Netherlands) via PDOK. Contains 130 statistical variables covering demographics, households, housing, energy consumption, social security, and proximity to facilities (CBS publication 'Statistische gegevens per vierkant en postcode 2022-2023-2024'). Counts are measured on 1 January; energy figures cover a calendar year. Privacy protected: postcodes with fewer than 5 residents or 5 housing units are suppressed (value -99997). Data is supplemented over a 3-year period. Native CRS is EPSG:28992 (RD New / Amersfoort).
